title: Neighborhood pet-sitter booking
problem: Pet owners struggle to find trustworthy nearby sitters for short trips; sitters need a schedule and clear service scope to avoid disputes.
background: SAMPLE INPUT for lane-workflow testing, chosen as a deliberately different domain from the wedding sample to prove reusability. Marketplace-style browsing plus a booking/request flow with structured service scope.

coreFlows.name: Find and book a sitter
steps: Browse nearby sitters filtered by pet type and dates
Open a sitter profile with reviews and service scope
Request booking with pet details and dates

coreFlows.name: Sitter handles a request
steps: Review pet details and requested dates
Complete visit and log a care report

constraints: All user-facing copy must be written in Korean (service targets Korean users)
